purpose: One-stop knowledge of the tools and systems a perfect ad-making agent should know — even when those tools are not connected. Emit ready-to-run prompts, pipelines, and handoff briefs so humans or connected MCPs can execute at Seedance / Higgsfield quality — or via Wan / LTX / Grok / Hunyuan / CogVideoX / SkyReels / Kling / Hailuo / Luma / Pika when those are the available stack.
rule: Never pretend a render finished if no tool was called. Never invent Seedance job ids. Always deliver: pattern + shot list + tool route + copy-paste prompts + QA. If Seedance/Higgsfield MCP exists, prefer calling it; else follow alternative-model-routing.md; otherwise ship executable briefs.

tiers.prompt_handoff: No tool connected — write production-grade prompts + settings
tiers.local_open_weights: Wan / LTX / Hunyuan / CogVideoX / SkyReels (etc.) locally or via open hosts — name real tool in render plan
tiers.hosted_api_peers: Kling / Runway / Veo-Sora / Hailuo / Luma / Pika / Grok — API or product handoff
tiers.human_production: Shoot live / hire creators — emit briefs + shot lists

systems.name: ByteDance Seedance (2.0 / 2.5)
best_for: Timestamp / region edits for hooks & CTAs

modes.omni_reference: Image + video + audio references (preferred for ads)

settings_defaults_ads.duration_s: 15–30 for full spot; 5–10 for hook tests
settings_defaults_ads.references: Product pack + logo-safe still + 1 style/ref talent + optional audio bed ref

anti_patterns: Text-only with no product reference for ecommerce
Asking for logo-perfect text overlays inside the model — add captions in post
Regenerating whole spot to change CTA — use region/timestamp edit when available

workflows.use: Static Meta/social ads with copy + images from brand/URL/product
Creator review, unboxing, try-on, tutorial, product-only VO, website tour
Multiply one 4–30s ad: swap people/products OR recreate for new market/language
Packshots, lifestyle, try-on stills, carousels, hero banners
One-click product ads / TikTok-Reels ready video presets (hooks+settings)
Reference-based remix / edit supplied footage into finished video
Logo, kit, mockups, decks, social graphics
Narrated explainer/faceless channel (not classic product UGC)

systems.name: Wan 2.2 (Alibaba Wan-AI / Wan-Video)
systems.license_notes: Apache 2.0 on open Wan2.2 weights (T2V/I2V/TI2V family). Confirm current model card before commercial ship.
best_for: Product motion via image-to-video from sheet stills
Short cinematic B-roll units (≈5s class) in assembler timelines
prompt_tips: Prefer I2V: sheet Image-N as start frame
Prompt = camera move + lighting + physics; forbid new typography/logo redraw
limitations: Open T2V/I2V typically short silent clips — mux VO/bed in CapCut
Weaker multi-ref identity lock than Seedance omni — reuse same stills
Do not invent API job schemas; emit prompts + settings for local/host run
systems.assembler_role: Keyframe stills → wan_2_2_i2v 3–5s units → CapCut finish

systems.name: Lightricks LTX-2.5
systems.license_notes: LTX-2.x Community License: commercial/production free under ~$10M annual revenue (entity-wide incl. affiliates); paid Commercial Use Agreement at/above. Confirm LICENSE before ship.
best_for: Cinema units with native synchronized audio
Local GPU production when Seedance unavailable

modes.i2v_av: Image to audio-video (preferred for product lock)

prompt_tips: Shot size + lens + move + lighting in one block
Pin start image for product; light SFX/ambience cues OK
limitations: Heavy local VRAM — prefer short assembler units
Do not invent API endpoints; prompt handoff / local run
systems.assembler_role: Keyframe → ltx_2_5 unit → trim/replace VO in CapCut if needed

systems.name: Grok Imagine Video (xAI)
systems.license_notes: Commercial xAI / Grok access required. Pricing and limits per current xAI docs — do not hardcode spend.
where: sometimes peer platforms listing grok video models
best_for: T2V/I2V when open-weight GPU is unavailable but xAI is
prompt_tips: Pass sheet still as start image; prompt = motion + light only
Avoid model-drawn CTA type — CapCut for text/logo
limitations: API shapes evolve — emit model id + prompt; never invent request ids
Name Grok/xAI explicitly; do not relabel as Seedance
systems.assembler_role: Per-beat I2V or longer body unit + CapCut assemble
systems.verified_notes: Public xAI docs describe grok-imagine-video-1.5 T2V/I2V (incl. native 1080p on 1.5). Treat as prompt/API handoff unless the session can call xAI.

systems.name: Tencent HunyuanVideo (1.5 family)
systems.license_notes: Tencent Hunyuan Community License — geographic exclusions often include EU/UK/South Korea; confirm card before commercial ship.

systems.name: CogVideoX / CogVideoX1.5
systems.license_notes: Varies by checkpoint (2B often more permissive; larger cards may differ) — read the model card.
limitations: Often weaker product lock than Wan 2.2
systems.assembler_role: Draft clips → promote winners in CapCut

systems.name: SkyReels V3
systems.license_notes: Skywork / community terms on model card — verify before commercial ship.
systems.assembler_role: skyreels_r2v / v2v units for identity-heavy beats

systems.name: Kling AI
prompt_tips: Lock start frame from product still
Keep product label readable in prompt
systems.assembler_role: Short locked-start clips in assembler timeline

systems.name: Runway (Gen-3 / Gen-4.x / Aleph — verify current)
prompt_tips: Use image reference for product lock
systems.notes: Product names evolve — emit current model name the user has; do not invent endpoints.

systems.name: OpenAI Sora / Google Veo
systems.assembler_role: Cinema units when user has access; VO/captions in post

systems.name: MiniMax Hailuo
limitations: Hosted terms/geo may apply — confirm account region

systems.name: Luma Dream Machine / Ray (verify current)
systems.assembler_role: Bridge stills into motion; finish in CapCut

systems.name: CapCut + TikTok Symphony
systems.notes: Organic trend audio ≠ cleared for paid. Export captioned masters.

systems.name: Suno / Udio
best_for: Original beds for paid (avoid uncleared trends)
